pr_title: fix(core): ICU expression previous value not removed inside template
pr_body:
Fixes an issue where the previous value of an ICU expression wasn't being
removed, if it didn't have an `other` parameter and it's the last value inside
a template. The issue is due to the `createDynamicNodeAtIndex` function
which sets a new node at a particular index inside the `LView`, but it doesn't
account for any node that may have existed there beforehand. Since we've
overwritten the reference, we don't have a way of removing the node from
the DOM anymore.

Also cleans up an optional parameter in one of the internal functions and
adds stronger typing to the i18n unit tests.

Fixes #38073.
pr_comments: My understanding of the entire process is somewhat high level, but I think the way it's set up is that it'll remove the old node next time it runs through the entire routine. If we reset it back to null, next time around it won't be able to remove the node since it doesn't know the index from last time.

From what I can see, all the iterations of the `ngFor` loop use the same `icuTNode`, which means that on each loop the following happens:

1. remove the previous iteration's active case
2. create the current iteration's active case
3. update the current iteration's active case

This seems wrong to me... if the `icuTNode` is shared across all the ngFor iterations, then I would think it is not the right place to store the `activeCaseIndex`, right?

And I think it is this weird sharing that is causing the first iteration to be updated incorrectly, since the `activeCaseIndex`, from the last iteration, in the previous loop, is `null` it doesn't remove its previous active case before adding the new active case.
I see what you mean now. Setting this back to draft and I'll take a better look later.
Hi @crisbeto, it looks like https://github.com/angular/angular/commit/6d8c73a4d62380bd7cfcaeaa23d5db802467d485 supersedes the changes in this PR? If that's the case, can we close this PR? Thank you.

issue_context.title: Duplicate text when using ICU expression in list without 'other'
issue_context.body:
# 🐞 bug report ### Affected Package The issue is caused by package @angular/.... ### Is this a regression? Pretty sure this wasn't an issue in Angular 7. Noticed the issue after updating to Angular 9. ### Description When using an ICU select expression inside a list, if you do not include the "other" placeholder, then subsequent changes to an item in the list causes the replacement text to display twice. Issue #34018 suggests that the "other" case should actually be required but this is now no longer enforced. It might be worth reinstating the warning if this is deemed not to be a bug. ## 🔬 Minimal Reproduction https://stackblitz.com/edit/angular-ivy-cuoymq?file=src%2Fapp%2Fapp.component.html ## 🌍 Your Environment **Angular Version:**

comments:

Yes, this seems to be a bug. While ICU may require `other` I don't see a reason why that should affect the runtime algorithm.

review_comments:
I think it'd be great to add a couple more tests/checks that would:
- update the value of an element that was not rendered originally (i.e. `items[2].value` in this case) and set the value to one of the conditions present in ICU
- change the value of an element that correspond to one of the cases in ICU (e.g. '1') to a value that would not be matched by ICU conditions (e.g. '5')

May be also copy all these tests for a standalone ICU (i.e. outside of an `ngFor`).

I've added the extra test cases. As for copying them to be without an `ngFor`, I didn't do it because I wasn't able to reproduce the issue without it. I think it has more to do with the number of nodes than the template definition itself.
